summary.verdict: BOTH ESKAPE pathogens VALIDATE — extends the experimental validation to a FOURTH and FIFTH organism, incl. the SECOND held-out NEWBUG pathogen. A. baumannii (HELD-OUT, DEG1043 Wang-2014 INSeq): FBA-essential enriched for experimental essential at OR 12.75 (p=2.84e-06), precision 0.235. P. aeruginosa (panel, DEG1036 Turner-2015 Tn-seq): OR 22.66 (p=0.0), precision 0.569. So the mechanism signal now validates against experiment in FIVE organisms — E. coli, Mtb, and THREE ESKAPE pathogens (K. pneumoniae + A. baumannii held-out, P. aeruginosa) — with TWO of them genuinely held out of development. HONEST BOUNDS: binary enrichment (precision high, recall 0.235/0.248 — FBA metabolic-scoped); AUROC modest (0.5992/0.63); symbol-mapping coverage (adjudicable 1137/1652, skews to named core genes); DEG A. baumannii is a lung-persistence INSeq set (condition-specific); essentiality only, not drug-target/clinical.
